property_summary: For every admissible call that sends exactly 10 ether and advances time, the reference contract only empties its balance and returns funds to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0, whereas the mutant always transfers the balance, so the general rule is: after a successful fallback call with msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, address(c).balance == 0 iff block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant violates this by making balance 0 for some inputs where block.number % 15 != 0.
change_summary: Always perform the transfer regardless of block number by removing the if condition, which changes whether the contract balance is sent out after the call.
